definitions.meaning: An hereditary relic, heirloom, what is left of an inheritance, inheritance, heir

quotations.old_english: Hé fédeþ folc Iacobes and Israhéla yrfeláfe
quotations.latin: pascere Jacob servum suum, et Israel hæreditatem suam

quotations.english: to each he gave a gift, an heirloom

quotations.old_english: Hé bátwearde swurd gesealde, ðæt hé syððan wæs mádme ðý weorðra, yrfeláfe
Wolde líge gesyllan his swǽsne sunu ángan ofer eorþan yrfeláfe
quotations.english: he [Abraham] was ready to give to the flame, his dear son, the only heir that was left him on earth

source_text: irfe-láf, e; f. An hereditary relic, heirloom, what is left of an inheritance, inheritance, heir :-- Hé fédeþ folc Iacobes and Israhéla yrfeláfe pascere Jacob servum suum, et Israel hæreditatem suam, Ps. Th. 77, 70. Æ-acute;ghwylcum máððum gesealde yrfeláfe to each he gave a gift, an heirloom, Beo.Th. 2110; B. 1053. Hé bátwearde swurd gesealde, ðæt hé syððan wæs mádme ðý weorðra, yrfeláfe, 3810; B. 1903. Wolde líge gesyllan his swǽsne sunu ángan ofer eorþan yrfeláfe he [Abraham] was ready to give to the flame, his dear son, the only heir that was left him on earth, Cd. 162; Th. 203, 14 ; Exod. 403.
